_comment: Pipeline tuning knobs. Edit and restart the backend to apply. All fields optional — defaults in backend/src/config.py.
_model_help: extraction_model: gpt-5.5 = stronger verbatim discipline, ~5x cost vs mini. gpt-5.4-mini = cheap, more variable.
_temperature_help: extraction_temperature: 0 = greedy (most stable, still not byte-identical per OpenAI seed best-effort). 0.2-0.5 = some variance, occasionally surfaces new framings. 1.0 = max creativity.
_seed_help: extraction_seed: pin to an int for closer reproducibility (best-effort per OpenAI). null = no seed.
_top_goals_help: top_goals: hard cap on goals surfaced per brief. Threaded into both the LLM prompt AND the post-dedup truncation, so one number stays consistent end-to-end. 3-4 is the sweet spot for a QBR; 5+ usually drags in noise.
_narration_help: narration_model + narration_temperature: s5 narrates rule-detected gaps + opportunities into AM-facing prose. Default 0.0 favours stable re-runs of the same brief. Crank to 0.3-0.5 if you want re-runs to occasionally surface different framings.
